items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I went on the road with Dan Moody's band out of Buccaloosa. We traveled all over Tennessee, Louisiana, Mississippi. I stayed with him about three years.

ctx.x: That's for the whole band or a piece? A piece.

The Tips was great. The salaries wasn't them, but the Tips was great. Then after I went with Tips Howard then, I stayed with him for a long while. Then I left. I went on the road with Dan Moody's band out of Buccaloosa. We traveled all over Tennessee, Louisiana, Mississippi. I stayed with him about three years. I came back. I went back with Kit Howard. I worked with Kit Howard about two years. Then I went with George Williams. I stayed with George Williams a long time. Then after George went to work at the…
